method.hypothesis: An LLM finds and fixes flaws that rules miss, but only a deterministic verifier makes its output safe to ship: rules + LLM + verifier (hybrid) finds more flaws than rules alone and breaks no apps, while the LLM alone breaks some.
method.groundTruth: corpus: corpus/ground-truth.json; dvna: corpus/external/dvna-ground-truth.json (documented flaws only); raw/hardened: no ground truth
method.httpTest: hybrid arm runs the two-mode HTTP test except on dvna (never executed)
